description: Comprehensive wallet safety check: scans approvals, analyzes recent transaction activity for suspicious patterns, and assesses target contract risk. Returns composite risk score (0-100), risk level, action items, and related service suggestions. Supports EVM chains and Solana. Free over MCP for 10 calls per day; beyond that the tool returns the pay-per-call x402 endpoint and its price.

depth.description: Analysis depth: quick (approvals only), standard (approvals + activity), deep (extended history + all patterns)

targetContract.description: Optional target contract address to assess before interaction

walletAddress.description: Wallet address to check (0x-prefixed for EVM, base58 for Solana)

name: wallet_safety
